hero.title: Welcome to Your Creative Command Center
hero.subtitle: Moodboard Manager is your all-in-one visual workspace for bringing characters and stories to life. Whether you're crafting graphic novels, designing character concepts, or writing comic scripts, everything you need is right here—organized, offline-ready, and synced across your devices.

step1.title: Create Your First Project
step1.description: Click 'New Project' on the home screen. You can quick capture an idea with just a description, or do a full setup with name and tags.
step1.tip: Wake up with an idea? Write it down, so you don't lose it. You can add a proper name later!

step2.title: Add Characters
step2.description: Characters are the heart of your project. Add name, age, role, personality traits, and upload reference images for visual inspiration.
step2.tip: Add custom fields for anything you need: 'Weapon', 'Catchphrase', 'Home Planet'—you name it!

step3.title: Start Creating
step3.description: Jump into Grid View for a gallery of references, Canvas Mode for an infinite visual workspace, or Editions to write your comic script.
step3.tip: Use Canvas mode to create mood sheets for specific scenes or chapters!

projects.title: Project Management
projects.description: Quickly capture ideas or create full projects with metadata. Archive old projects, export as ZIP files, and organize with tags and filters. Edit project details anytime as your ideas evolve.

characters.title: Character Profiles
characters.description: Dive deep into every character with profiles, visual references, custom fields, and unlimited images. Each character gets their own dedicated space with personality traits, backstory, and more.

canvas.title: Visual Moodboard Canvas
canvas.description: Infinite workspace for visual storytelling. Drag & drop images, arrange freely, zoom & pan, lock items, and auto-extract color palettes. Think of it as your digital corkboard.

scripts.title: Comic Scripts
scripts.description: Write your comics panel by panel with the Editions feature. Organize by issues/volumes, break into pages, and script each panel with visual descriptions, camera angles, character dialogues, and SFX.

storage.title: Storage & Backup
storage.description: Local storage with OPFS for ultra-fast access. Full backup/restore via ZIP export. Storage monitor shows exactly how much space you're using. Your data stays safe offline.

sync.title: Google Drive Auto-Sync
sync.description: Ultimate backup solution—sync projects, characters, scripts, and images across all devices. Work offline, sync when back online. Built-in conflict resolution for safe merging.

pwa.title: Progressive Web App
pwa.description: Install as a native app for faster load times, full offline functionality, and standalone window. Works on desktop and mobile with no app store required.

characterDesign.title: Character Design
characterDesign.step1: Create new project: 'My Comic - Character Designs'
characterDesign.step3: Upload reference images (costume sketches, pose studies)
characterDesign.step4: Switch to Canvas mode and arrange costume refs on the left, poses on the right
characterDesign.step5: Export when ready for artist handoff

quickCapture.title: Quick Capture → Full Project
quickCapture.step1: Wake up with a story idea, click 'New Project'
quickCapture.step2: Skip the name, type the idea in the description
quickCapture.step4: Later: Edit project details, add a proper name
quickCapture.step5: Come back later to develop into a full project with characters and script

comicScript.title: Writing a Comic Script
comicScript.step3: Go to Editions tab → New Edition, set up 24 pages
comicScript.step4: Add panels page by page with visual descriptions
comicScript.step5: Write dialogue with character links and share via Export

crossDevice.title: Cross-Device Collaboration
crossDevice.step1: Enable Google Drive Sync on Desktop
crossDevice.step3: Open the app on your tablet and log in to the same Google account
crossDevice.step5: Make edits on tablet, see updates on desktop after syncing

quickCapture.title: Quick Capture Workflow
quickCapture.description: Ideas can strike at any time. Wake up with an idea? Open the app, new project, type a description so you don't forget! Come back later to fill in project details at your own pace.

imageManagement.title: Image Management
imageManagement.description: Bulk upload multiple files at once. Tag images with keywords like 'reference', 'final', 'inspiration'.

canvasOrganization.title: Canvas Organization
canvasOrganization.description: Use pinch-to-zoom on touch devices, mouse wheel on desktop. Lock background images so you don't accidentally move them. Use 'Bring to Front' to create visual hierarchy.

scriptWriting.title: Script Writing
scriptWriting.description: Set a clear goal for each page. Link dialogues to character profiles for consistency. Use the notes field for artist direction.

sync.title: Sync Issues
sync.solution: Check your internet connection, re-authenticate Google Drive in Settings → Cloud Sync.

storage.title: Storage Issues
storage.solution: Export the project as ZIP, delete unused projects/images, or enable Google Drive sync to offload local storage.

images.title: Image Upload Issues
images.solution: Check file format (JPG, PNG, WEBP supported), make sure file size is under ~50MB, and check browser console for errors.

performance.title: Canvas Performance
performance.problem: Canvas is slow with many images
performance.solution: Reduce the number of images on the canvas, lock items you're not actively moving, or reload the page to clear memory.

cta.title: You're Ready!
cta.description: You now have everything you need to organize visual references, create character profiles, write comic scripts, and sync across all your devices. Start creating!
